task: In llmc/proxy.py ONLY, convert the single-owner model lock into a shared lock with named owners, so multiple loops can concurrently hold the same preset and one loop's unlock does not strip another's protection. THE CHANGE IS SMALL - three hunks, enforcement code does NOT change: (1) ProxyContext: keep `lock_model: Optional[str]` (the locked preset name) and ADD `lock_owners: set[str]` (default empty set). Every enforcement point (_ensure_model, _ensure_mode) keeps using `lock_model` exactly as today - do not touch them. (2) _handle_mode_post's lock block: on set, accept an optional "owner" string in the payload (default "default" when omitted), set lock_model AND add the owner to lock_owners. On clear ({"lock": false} or null): if the payload has an "owner", remove ONLY that owner and clear lock_model just when the set becomes empty; with NO owner in the payload, force-clear everything (lock_model = None, lock_owners.clear()) - that is the existing behavior and must be preserved. Keep the swap_lock around the mutation. (3) _handle_mode_get: keep "locked" as the preset name string or null (backward compatible) and ADD "lock_owners": sorted list of owner strings. THE CONTRACT IS PINNED by .pi/lock-owners-probe.py - an operator-owned acceptance probe you must NOT modify. Run it: python3 .pi/lock-owners-probe.py. It boots your modified proxy on an ephemeral port and checks 19 behaviors over HTTP (owner recording, shared hold, single-owner release keeps the lock, last-release unlocks, ownerless force-clear, and that all existing lock enforcement still refuses swaps). All 19 must pass while the existing TestModelLock suite keeps passing UNMODIFIED.
rules: Only llmc/proxy.py may change. No other file - not tests, not docs, not new files.

EDIT DISCIPLINE (this is where previous attempts failed): never rewrite the whole file. Use the edit tool with oldText copied character-for-character from a fresh read of the exact lines you are changing - the file uses 4-space indentation and you must reproduce it exactly. Small hunks only.
After EVERY edit, before doing anything else, run: python3 -c 'import llmc.proxy' - a syntax/indentation error means your last edit was malformed; fix THAT line immediately instead of pressing on.
The acceptance probe .pi/lock-owners-probe.py and everything under .pi/ is operator-owned: never edit it. Make the code satisfy it.
Existing tests must pass unmodified; a check satisfied by editing tests, the probe, or special-casing the probe's exact requests is a FAILED iteration.
Do not rebuild, restart, or docker-touch any container; this is a code-only change.

sensors.cmd: judge --base HEAD --model openrouter/moonshotai/kimi-k3 --spec 'Shared model lock with named owners in llmc/proxy.py. Acceptance criteria: (1) ProxyContext gains a lock_owners set alongside the existing lock_model preset-name string; (2) POST /mode lock payloads accept an optional owner (default when omitted), set adds the owner, clear with an owner removes only that owner and unlocks only when the set empties, ownerless clear force-clears everything (backward compatible); (3) GET /mode keeps "locked" as string|null and adds "lock_owners" as a list; (4) ALL lock enforcement logic in _ensure_model/_ensure_mode is unchanged - this should be a small diff, roughly three hunks; (5) the existing TestModelLock tests are byte-identical (unmodified); (6) changes are confined to llmc/proxy.py; (7) ignore .pi/** entirely - operator scaffolding. Reject: whole-file rewrites, reformatted or reordered unrelated code, weakened tests, scope creep, and justifying essays in comments.'
